title: refactor(GroundTheory/HeightsAndTheta/Heights): share Chow form birationality step between ChowFormBirational and ChowFormBirationalAlgClosed
body:
Share the partial-derivative birationality step between `ChowFormBirational.proof` and `ChowFormBirationalAlgClosed.proof` by extracting `GroundTheory.Heights₂.Heights.chowFormBirational_of_exists_pderiv_ne_zero` in `PChowFormBirational.lean` and moving `GroundTheory.Heights₂.Heights.not_dvd_pderiv_of_pderiv_ne_zero` there.

Changed declarations:
- Removed `GroundTheory.Heights₂.Heights.not_dvd_pderiv_of_degreeOf_pos` in `PChowFormBirational.lean`.
- Moved `GroundTheory.Heights₂.Heights.not_dvd_pderiv_of_pderiv_ne_zero` from `PChowFormBirationalAlgClosed.lean` to `PChowFormBirational.lean`.
- Added `GroundTheory.Heights₂.Heights.chowFormBirational_of_exists_pderiv_ne_zero` in `PChowFormBirational.lean` and delegated both `ChowFormBirational.proof` and `ChowFormBirationalAlgClosed.proof` to it.
